title: IDE configs name the clone's own build, not one laptop's
goal: T-AGENT2026102817540410895-1 also checked in .vscode/settings.json (mcp.servers), .idea/mcp.json, .idea/externalTools.xml and .agents/susi-ide-harness.json naming F:/src/github.com/intellibitz/susi/target/debug/susi.exe and SUSI_HOME=C:/Users/user/.susi: every other clone (another laptop, a cloud session's container) gets a dead path. Point each at the clone's own target/debug/susi through the IDE's own project macro where it has one (VS Code ${workspaceFolder}, IntelliJ $ProjectFileDir$), drop the SUSI_HOME override, and extend tests/checked_in_mcp_config.rs so no quoted value in any of these files names a machine path.
